title: [review] messaging.py:121: Validation allows non-string b
description: The check `isinstance(body.get('body'), str) or isinstance(body.get('text'), str)` accepts input like `{'body': 123, 'text': 'hello'}`. Since 'body' exists (as int), lines 138-139 do not copy text to body, storing the non-string body=123. Downstream code or legacy views expecting body to be a string will receive an integer.
